Authorization Tracker

Every client's prior auth in one list, sorted by urgency. Red = act now — visits nearly used up, or the auth expires soon. Visit #21 on a 20-visit auth pays zero, so this list is money. Leave "visits approved" blank if the payer doesn't cap visits (date-only auth).

Payer Coverage Matrix

One row per code, one column per payer. Set each cell to what that payer actually does: Covered Prior auth Not covered Unknown. Add your contracted rate if you know it. Green/red counts under a cell come from the Denial Log — real approvals and denials you've recorded.

Tip: if the two locations are in different coverage areas, add the payer once per location. Rates CSV format: Payer,Code,Rate,Status (status optional: covered / pa / no).

Same-Day Combination Checker

Pick two codes to see whether they can be billed on the same date of service, and what it takes (distinct sessions, modifier 59). These reflect common NCCI edits and general payer behavior — your Denial Log is the final word for each payer.

Recruiting — TN therapist call list

About this tool

This tool helps staff code services that were actually delivered and documented — it is a coding accuracy and revenue-capture aid, not a substitute for payer policy. CPT® codes are © the AMA. NCCI edits and payer rules change quarterly: when this tool and a current payer policy disagree, the payer policy wins. Log the outcome so the tool learns.
